meetings.title: Booth design review
transcript: Maya: Let's look at the booth. Sam, walk us through it.
Sam: The back wall has one line: every truck on time. The live demo runs on the big screen, and a tablet station lets people book a slot themselves.
Leila: The tablet flow uses the real slot picker, so it has to be stable by next Wednesday.
Maya: Can we show Coastal's real numbers on the screen?
Sam: Anonymized, yes. Jordan got the data from Grace.
Maya: Good. What's left for the printed one-pager?
Sam: Pricing. I'm waiting on final numbers.
Maya: You'll have them by Friday.
Leila: One ask: freeze the slot picker design now. Changes after Monday won't make it.
Sam: Agreed. No more design changes after today.

slack.author: jordan
slack.text: Escalation: Omar from Ridgeline says 9 trucks were double-booked at their Reno DC this morning and drivers are waiting at the gate. Third time this quarter.

slack.author: jordan
slack.text: Made TW-133 for the fix and TW-134 for a call with Omar today.

slack.author: nina
slack.text: Sync errors at Reno were 4.2% overnight, all duplicates. Same pattern as TW-103.

slack.author: jordan
slack.text: Omar just copied Ridgeline's CFO. He wants a call before noon.

slack.author: arjun
slack.text: Retry queue is running in staging (TW-104). The merged ranking from TW-116 is going into the scoring API.

slack.author: maya
slack.text: Fourteen days to FreightWorks. Booth review at 11.

slack.author: sam
slack.text: Demo screens 1 and 2 are done (TW-119). Screen 3 needs the slot picker build.

jira.comment: Fresno appointments now show local time.

Deck drafted. Final numbers tomorrow morning.
